# hivenet_instance (Data Source)

Reads one of your instances by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivenet_instance" "training" {
  id = "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6"
}

output "training_status" {
  value = data.hivenet_instance.training.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Instance ID (UUID).

### Read-Only

- `bandwidth_mbps` (Number) Allocated bandwidth, in Mbps.
- `cpu_count` (Number) Virtual CPUs allocated.
- `gpu_type` (String) GPU model, e.g. `RTX 4090`.
- `guest_ready` (String) Whether the guest OS is reachable: `READY`, `DEGRADED` or `UNKNOWN`.
- `guest_ready_reason` (String) Explanation when the guest is not ready. Null otherwise.
- `hourly_rate` (Number) Price per hour while running, in credits.
- `location` (String) Datacenter the instance runs in, e.g. `france-2`. This is narrower than a region and cannot be used as the `region` filter of `hivenet_presets`.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `resources` (String) Human-readable summary of the allocated hardware.
- `size` (String) Headline shape, e.g. `8 x GPU`.
- `started_at` (String) When the instance last entered `RUNNING` (RFC 3339). Null if it never has.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle state, e.g. `RUNNING`, `STOPPED` or `TERMINATED`.
- `storage_gb` (Number) Disk provisioned for the instance, in GB.
- `terminated_at` (String) When the instance was terminated (RFC 3339). Null if it has not been.
- `termination_reason` (String) Why the instance was terminated, e.g. `USER_INITIATED` or `CREDIT_EXHAUSTION`. Null if it has not been.
- `total_cost_incurred` (Number) Total cost over the instance's life, in credits.
- `total_runtime_hours` (Number) Total hours the instance has spent running.
